The '''Mimban campaign''' was a prolonged battle that took place on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] during [[Eternal Empire conquest|the conquest]] that the [[Eternal Empire]] led against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Jedi Under Siege|Ossus}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] participated in the grueling struggle and managed to survive despite the severe losses that their side suffered. The two Jedi regrouped following the campaign and relocated to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and were the sole survivors of the campaign.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Tau Idair}}</ref>
